perf.summary: q/inq/cnt stackalloc reside inside while(true) and dist/parent re-init each iteration; hoist the buffers.
perf.currentCost: Three stackalloc (int[n], byte[n], int[n]) plus a full init loop occur per augmenting iteration. The buffers persist to method end anyway (stackalloc is not freed per loop), so re-declaring them only confuses the frame and forces re-zeroing logic each pass.
perf.proposedChange: Hoist q, inq, cnt stackalloc above while(true); keep the per-iteration reset loop for inq/cnt (still required), but allocate once. Combine the inq/cnt/dist/parent resets into a single pass over i since they are all length n.
perf.rationale: Single stack reservation; one fused reset loop instead of two separate loops over [0,n) (the dist/parent loop and the inq/cnt loop), halving loop overhead and improving streaming write locality.
perf.risk: None for hoisting (stackalloc lifetime is method scope regardless). Fusing resets is safe because all arrays are length n and independent.
